name: Gale Reef
imageAlt: A diver beside a wall of colorful coral
description: Gale Reef invites you to slow down and notice the small things. Explore a sheltered coral garden, where a patient pause reveals more than a hurried lap.
bestFor: First reef visits and unhurried observation
fieldNote: Choose one patch of reef and watch how its smallest residents move through the coral.

name: Dawson's Reef
imageAlt: A diver and small reef fish above colorful coral
description: Dawson's Reef turns a day in the water into a study of movement. Follow the reef's changing contours and look for the brief patterns that appear as fish cross the blue.
bestFor: Underwater photography and watching reef life
fieldNote: Frame the reef first, then wait for a passing fish to become part of the picture.

name: Claire's Reef
imageAlt: Pale and orange coral beneath clear blue water
description: Claire's Reef offers a wider perspective on the island below the surface. Trace the contrast between intricate coral forms and the open blue beyond the reef.
bestFor: Experienced divers exploring with a guide
fieldNote: Look for the reef's silhouette against the blue before focusing on its finer details.

name: Kayak Bay Sunrise Shallows
description: Paddle a sheltered bay at first light, beach the kayaks on a quiet sandbar, and slip into shallow seagrass and coral patches with a guide who knows every resident turtle.
imageAlt: Colorful sea kayaks resting on a sandy beach beside a calm bay
bestFor: Snorkelers who want a gentle paddle-in start before deeper reef days
fieldNote: Launch before the afternoon breeze; the sandbar is reachable only on a falling tide.
